hypothesis: A learned chronological representation of the last eight actually observed POSITION states can recover transferable HOLD-value ordering that current-state models and hand-crafted path summaries failed to capture.
frozen: no recurrent trading-policy replay in this representation experiment

candidate_representation.encoding: Fixed chronological lag slots ending at the current observed state, with causal age features and padding masks. The MLP learns interactions directly; no manually chosen slope/std/range summaries are provided as the new representation.
candidate_representation.causality: Only current and prior observations are allowed. Future timestamps, future prices, future gaps, labels, and hindsight best values are forbidden.

comparators: current-state-only MLP with the same rank objective
good_day_definition: Daily Spearman > 0 and the top 10% of sequence scores have positive mean realized next-event HOLD advantage.
forbidden: tuning sequence length, hidden size, source list or gate after seeing June 23/24/25/26/29 results
using future observation timing as an input
claiming a profitable trading policy from a ranking-only result
next_if_pass: Freeze the sequence representation, calibrate an absolute HOLD/EXIT value rule using historical fit/calibration only, then replay recurrent event-time trajectories.
next_if_fail: Stop adding representation features and challenge the one-step next-event HOLD target itself with multi-event continuation / remaining-option-value objectives.
